reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the fix preventing repeated CIDRs from duplicating their own accumulated L4 rules. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #771 by preventing repeated CIDRs from copying their own accumulated L4 rules in cluster policy map computation, eliminating exponential rule-list growth. **Changes:** - Skip rule inheritance when the overlapping CIDR equals the current CIDR. - Add a 20-rule regression test that checks the resulting port count and keeps allocations below 10 MB. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `pkg/​fwruleprocessor/​fw_rule_processor.go` | Guards against copying a CIDR’s rules onto itself. | | `pkg/​fwruleprocessor/​fw_rule_processor_test.go` | Adds regression coverage for repeated-CIDR output and memory usage. |
Review effort: Balanced
